provenance: User supplied Tripo drafts for this project; no independent license assertion.
process: User-supplied boy_web_noanim/girl_web_noanim surfaces and UVs; source Mixamo 65-joint skin reposed and mapped to 49 identity-axis runtime joints with model-specific bind positions; corrected head/torso influences and welded seam weights; maximum four normalized influences; whole-surface near/far LODs, one shared material; female seated skirt corrective; lossless Meshopt geometry. No new character generated from a reference image.
textureAtlas: One original 2048x2048 RGB colour WebP per character, byte-preserved from the supplied GLB and shared across LODs/instances. No normal or metallic-roughness maps in this source. WebP reduces transfer only; KTX2 GPU compression is not applied.

limitations: Source surface only; no concealed body reconstruction
